recipe.visualDefinition: A technical blueprint aesthetic featuring a central isometric wireframe structure composed of extruded geometric letterforms, set against a dark blue grid background with white drafting lines, measurements, and technical annotations.
coreVisualRelationships: White technical lines against a deep navy blue field
Alignment of text and graphics to a rigid underlying grid system
Contrast between thin drafting lines and bold, solid sans-serif typography
coreInvariants: Monochromatic blue and white color scheme
Uniform line weight for the grid and wireframe
Presence of drafting markers like degree arcs and coordinate letters

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large, complex isometric wireframe occupies the central 70% of the frame, tilted at a diagonal angle.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold sans-serif text in the top corners provides a stable horizontal anchor against the diagonal movement of the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal lines of the isometric structure from the bottom left to the top right, framed by the corner text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The grid acts as active negative space, providing texture without cluttering the technical focus.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark background and bright white foreground elements; low saturation overall.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Forward slash used as a separator with specific vertical alignment

composition.position: Top left and top right margins
Bottom right corner within a technical box

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold display sans-serif paired with a lighter, condensed technical version of the same style.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Helvetica Bold or Neue Haas Grotesk
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, mid-century modernist aesthetic of the display text.
Modern alternatives that maintain the geometric neutrality.
Ideal for the technical metadata text in the bottom corner.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark navy blue background with a fine white grid. In the center, place a large isometric wireframe of 3D block letters tilted at a 45-degree angle. Add technical drafting elements like degree arcs, coordinate letters (A-T) on the left, and numbers (1-20) on the bottom. Include a small rectangular title block in the bottom right corner.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, white, uppercase geometric sans-serif text in the top left and top right corners. Ensure the tracking is tight. Add small, condensed technical text inside the bottom-right title block.

verificationChecks: Is the background a consistent dark blue?
Are all lines white and of a uniform thin weight?
Is the central structure strictly isometric?
Is the typography uppercase and sans-serif?

adjustableVariables: Specific blue hue (from cyan to navy)
Line weight of the drafting elements
mustRedesign: Specific project titles in the metadata box
postGenerationChecks: Check that the grid lines are perfectly horizontal and vertical.
Ensure the isometric angles are consistent (30 or 45 degrees).
Verify that the text does not overlap the central wireframe.
Confirm the color palette is strictly limited to blue and white.
recipe.reuseFormula: Blueprint Grid + Isometric Wireframe + Bold Corner Typography = Technical Modernist Aesthetic
